messages:
jen_support: Hey team — onboarding blocked for customer acct_4392. They tried to apply promo TRIAL2026 but the flow requires a card on file and the tokenization/3DS dance is failing. Customer sees ‘payment method required before trial’ even though card was added.

raj_billing: Can you paste the payment intent / token ids and a screenshot if possible? Is the 3DS challenge returning an explicit decline or timeout? :thinking_face:

jen_support: Payment intent: `pi_1JXx0Gk2` , payment_method: `pm_24zAaY`. The issuer sent a 3DS challenge then later we saw a webhook with `status: requires_action` followed by a `canceled` event. No webhook for `payment_intent.succeeded`. Screenshot attached in thread. Customer reports they completed challenge but the issuer window closed and the payment status moved to `canceled`.

kyle_payments: Thats the issuer bounce pattern we've seen in EU issuers where challenge is issued but an intermediate redirect times out. Our webhooks should have a retry but here it looks like the challenge result never completed. Any logs from the tokenization service?

jen_support: Pasting the webhook trace (sanitized):
```
POST /webhooks/payment 200 OK
{ "id": "evt_pi_canceled", "type": "payment_intent.canceled", "data": { "id": "pi_1JXx0Gk2", "status": "canceled", "last_payment_error": { "message": "3DS challenge timeout from issuer" } } }
```

raj_billing: Hmm. The promo grant job runs only after `payment_intent.succeeded` or if account is flagged for bypass. Since we never got succeeded, promo wasn't applied. We can manually grant but need root cause.

kyle_payments: Quick repro steps I want to run: 1) Create test PI with `confirm=true` and EU test BIN to force 3DS. 2) Simulate issuer challenge then simulate closing the challenge early to reproduce canceled event. 3) Inspect our gateway’s async callback handling and webhook retries.

sophie_ops: I saw a relay-layer timeout around the same time in the logs (10:12:07 -> 10:12:45). Looks like our callback ACK loop gave up after 30s. I'll re-run the webhook consumer with extended socket timeout and a patch to log response body.

jen_support: Customer is asking for an immediate workaround so they can trial. Can we grant trial credit manually? What's safe?

raj_billing: Yes — we can create a manual credit note for 90-day trial in Billing UI or via admin API: `POST /admin/accounts/acct_4392/credits {"amount": 30, "reason": "manual trial grant - onboarding blocked by 3DS"}`. Tag with `manual_3ds_escalation`. I'll do that once we have approval from payments.

kyle_payments: Approve — go ahead. Meanwhile I'll open an internal ticket to adjust the webhook consumer: increase retry window to 120s and add idempotency guard so late `payment_intent.succeeded` can still trigger promo grant. Also adding a small state machine to detect `requires_action` -> `succeeded` races.

jen_support: Thanks. Can someone DM me when the credit is applied so I can confirm with customer? Also need a short blurb explaining why the card seemed added but promo failed (for CS).

raj_billing: I'll apply the credit now and post confirmation.

payments-bot: Automated note: admin credit `cr_7732` created for acct_4392, amount 30, tag: manual_3ds_escalation.

jen_support: Got it, customer confirmed trial access restored.

kyle_payments: Follow-ups: (1) ticket PAY-8942 created to harden webhook/3DS handling, (2) add a diagnostic in the onboarding flow to show `payment_intent` lifecycle and link to our debug page, (3) PM to consider allowing promo grant on `requires_action` with a pending verification state for low-risk promos.

sophie_ops: I'll schedule a deploy of the webhook consumer patch in the next canary window and add extra logging for the next 72h. :eyes:

jen_support: Closing loop with customer now. Thanks all. :tada:
